steps.note: Check it: both ends match their pins and the summary is green.
A claim range is reported as a range of file lines.
Editing frontmatter does not move a claim.
A moved source is a warning that names the new range and exits 0.
`cite update --dry-run` previews the rewrite to the source end.
A changed source is an error beside a still-current claim, exit 1.
An inserted paragraph makes the claim moved: a notice, exit 0.
An edited sentence is claim-changed, a warning, exit 0.
Markers are read in MDX, AsciiDoc and reStructuredText.
A marker-anchored claim reads as marker plus the anchored line.
A quoted fenced block that still reproduces its source passes.
